title: Passive-Aggression: The Device
tagline: Finally, a solution for when politely worded notes and broom-handle ceiling jabs just aren't cutting it. This... *thing* lets you automate your noise complaints. Imagine: You're peacefully seething, and this mechanical menace is rhythmically annoying the oblivious upstairs dwellers. Because confronting people is *so* last century. Just remember, they'll probably buy one too. Enjoy the escalating war, broke-ass.

title: Bathroom Glamour in a Jar
tagline: Because your morning routine needs a touch of rustic chic. Perfect for those who want to feel like they're getting ready in a hipster café bathroom. The soft glow of the mason jar light will make your pimple-popping sessions look like a vintage Instagram filter. Who needs a mirror when you have this?

title: Lightbulb in a Birdcage
tagline: For when your vintage obsession needs a literal cage. Perfect for the coffee shop owner who wants their patrons to feel like they're drinking in a 19th-century asylum. The Edison bulb is a classic, but why stop there? Now you can trap it in a shadow box for that extra 'I'm trapped in the past' vibe.

title: Laziness: Now Motorized
tagline: For those nights when your remote is too far away but your cat’s on your lap. This kit turns your curtains into a high-tech barrier against sunlight—or nosy neighbors. Perfect for the homebody who’s mastered the art of doing nothing efficiently.

title: The Bookworm's Burrito
tagline: Tired of your Kindle slipping into the abyss of your pillow fortress? This is the reading equivalent of a taco shell for your torso. Perfect for those 'just one more chapter' marathons in your childhood bed, or when you're pretending to read while actually doomscrolling on your phone. Bonus: doubles as a body pillow for your existential dread.

title: Saber Scented Ambiance
tagline: Because your dinner parties were missing the scent of burning rebellion, these lightsaber candles bring a whiff of galaxy-saving chaos to your table.

title: The Blanket That Hugs Like a Yet
tagline: For those nights when your cat’s 10% body heat isn’t cutting it, wrap yourself in this 20-pound knit monstrosity. Perfect for winter camping in your living room or convincing your significant other you’re a burrito. Just don’t blame us when you forget how to use your arms.

title: Coffee Snobs' Nightcap
tagline: For those nights when your barista skills are on hiatus but your need for a third-wave experience isn't. Light this candle and pretend you're at a café in Florence, not your studio apartment. Bonus: no over-extracted bitterness, just the aroma of a perfectly pulled shot. Ideal for post-dinner 'I should cut back' moments.

title: The Blanket That Hugs Like a Viking
tagline: For when your regular blanket feels like a dishrag. This hand-knit beast is so chunky, it’ll make your cat think it’s wrestling a bear. Perfect for that one friend who insists on camping in a snowstorm but refuses to leave their coffee habit behind. Just don’t blame us when your heating bill drops to zero.

title: Time Tells It Like an Octopus
tagline: For the marine biologist who moonlights as a night owl, this clock is your eight-armed savior. Picture it: 3 AM, lab notes scattered, and your cephalopod companion subtly reminds you that even squids need sleep. Sure, it’s priced like a submarine, but when else will you see time displayed in tentacles?

title: Camouflage Condo, Desert Edition
tagline: So, you're telling me I can drop $1750 on…*nothing*? Perfect. Finally, a way to hide my questionable life choices from the HOA. Just picture it: a chrome mirage shimmering in the heat, reflecting my crippling existential dread back at itself. Tres chic.

title: Clocking Your Doom
tagline: Because your walls were missing a judging AI, this HAL 9000 clock will silently critique your tardiness, perfect for when you're running late to a sci-fi movie marathon.

title: Wet Dreams in Glass
tagline: For the friend who thinks a normal aquarium is too basic, these sculptures bring a mini-ecosystem to their desk, because what's a workspace without a tiny, self-sustaining pond?

title: Bendy Bookshelf for the Chronically Cluttered
tagline: For the person who can't decide between a bookshelf and a modern art piece, this flexible marvel bends to your whims—literally. Perfect for the college student who wants to impress their roommate with 'minimalist' decor while secretly hiding their ever-growing pile of unread textbooks behind it. At $1,400, it's cheaper than therapy for your OCD.

title: Plug Roulette Champion
tagline: For the digital nomad who’s tired of playing 'will this fit?' with foreign outlets. Perfect for that one friend who insists on working from a Bali villa but forgot their laptop charger. Comes with a built-in coin slot for when you inevitably need to reset the breaker.

title: TARDIS for Your Trash
tagline: Because your garbage deserves time-traveling dignity, use this TARDIS trash can when you need to dispose of last night's pizza in a vaguely British way.

title: Boozy Bottoms: The Stool That Swivels Like Your Regrets
tagline: For when your whiskey collection deserves a throne. Picture this: You're hosting a 'tasting' (read: trying to forget Tuesday) and your guests need a seat that swivels faster than their excuses. This stool isn't just furniture—it's a commitment to the bit. The wood smells like a forgotten speakeasy, and the swivel? Pure theatricality. Just don't blame us when your friends start spinning tales of their own.

title: Log Cabin for Your Plants
tagline: For when your succulents need a rustic getaway. These wooden log planters are perfect for the urban gardener who wants their plants to feel like they're on a permanent camping trip. Ideal for that one friend who insists their apartment is a 'tiny home' and their cacti are 'off-grid survivors'.

title: Moo Juice Glasses
tagline: Because your morning cereal deserves a nostalgic kick, serve it in a glass that resembles a milk carton. It's the perfect vessel for when you're eating Froot Loops alone in your pajamas, wondering where it all went wrong.

title: Succulent Squish Buddies
tagline: For when you want to hug a plant, but don't want the commitment of not killing it, these pillows are here to judge you silently.

title: Muggle Timekeeping, Magically Late
tagline: For when your Hogwarts acceptance letter arrives at 3 PM but you still need to know if it's time for tea. This clock won't turn back time, but it'll at least tell you if you're fashionably late to your Quidditch practice. Perfect for that one friend who insists they're a Hufflepuff but still can't find their keys.

title: Sleep Under the Stars (Literally)
tagline: For the insomniac who's convinced their ceiling is a planetarium. This duvet turns your bed into a cheap observatory—no telescope required. Perfect for the night owl who wants to argue with their partner about constellations at 3 AM, or the kid who thinks 'space' is a valid bedtime story. Just don’t blame us when you start dreaming in astronomical units.

title: Vader's Shower Side Hustle
tagline: Because your morning routine needs a Sith Lord, this showerhead brings Darth Vader's ominous presence to your bathroom. Imagine his deep breathing accompanying your shampooing – it's like a dark side meditation.

title: Stairway to the Stickers
tagline: Because your landlord won't let you paint, but also won't stop you from turning your staircase into a modern art exhibit. Perfect for the renter who wants to impress their guests with 'conceptual minimalism' while secretly knowing it's just tape on the stairs.

title: Trippy Bedroom Buddy
tagline: For when you want to question reality at 3am, this 3D illusion LED night light is perfect. Like, who needs sleep when you can stare at a floating cube?

title: Boil Water Like a Surgeon
tagline: For the over-caffeinated barista who insists their oat milk latte is a 'precision beverage.' This kettle heats water *just* enough to brew tea without scalding your tongue—because apparently, boiling water was too mainstream. Perfect for the coworker who brings a thermometer to the break room.

title: Glass Ceiling, Literally (Blown Glass)
tagline: For when your mid-century modern vibe needs a touch of 'I dropped my bong and it somehow became art.' This lamp is the perfect centerpiece for your 'accidentally chic' living room or the one friend who insists their apartment is a gallery. Bonus: It’s the only way to make your landlord’s cheap ceiling look intentional.

title: Scale That Judges You
tagline: Because your bathroom scale wasn't already passive-aggressive enough, now it tracks your heart rate, muscle mass, and hydration levels. Perfect for the health-conscious hypochondriac who needs to know if their 3 AM snack run has officially tipped them into 'pre-diabetic' territory. Comes with a built-in therapist—just don't ask about the price.

title: Flying Plant? I'm In.
tagline: Finally, a way to display your prized succulent that screams, "I peaked in college... but at least my plant is floating!" Perfect for confusing the cat, or staging a tiny alien invasion in your living room. Just try not to overwater, or you'll have a very grounded, very soggy situation.

title: Caped Crusader Couch Wear
tagline: For those nights when you're too tired to fight crime, but still want to lounge like Batman. This snuggie blanket is perfect for binge-watching Gotham while eating an entire pizza by yourself.

title: Birds in My Chandelier
tagline: Because your dinner parties were missing a copper birdcage hanging from the ceiling, now your guests can wonder if you're serving poultry or just eccentricity.

title: Booze Thief Foiler
tagline: For when you trust your roommates with everything except your whiskey, this lock ensures they won't 'accidentally' polish off your bourbon... again.

title: Jurassic Park...ing Problem Solved?
tagline: Neighbors complaining about your gnome collection? Assert dominance. This dino femur replica is perfect for baffling the HOA or adding that crucial 'prehistoric orthopedic exhibit' vibe to your next garden party. Just try explaining to your dog why you buried a 'bone' bigger than he is.

title: Yoga? Nah, Just Pillow Talk
tagline: For the zen master who’s more about the 'om' in 'snooze' than the 'om' in 'namaste'. Perfect for those mornings when your chakra alignment is more about the alignment of your duvet and less about downward dog. Because sometimes the best stretch is the one between your sheets and your pillow.

title: Spoke-tacular Lighting
tagline: For the urban cyclist who wants their living room to match their bike’s aesthetic. Perfect for that loft where the only thing brighter than your personality is the glare from your vintage hub caps. Ideal for a mid-century modern enthusiast who also enjoys the clank of derailleurs with their morning coffee.

title: Couch Potato's Anchor
tagline: For when your roommate insists on using your arm as a drink shelf. This weighted cup holder won't slide off the couch when you're halfway through your third episode of *The Office*. Perfect for marathon binge-watchers who refuse to pause for anything, even gravity.
